# lux-core — AI State Mirror

**This repository is automatically generated. Direct edits here may be
overwritten without warning.**

This is a read-only, automatically synchronized snapshot of project-state
artifacts from the canonical LUX engineering repository:
**[fsassaman-commits/lux-core](https://github.com/fsassaman-commits/lux-core)**.

It exists so an AI assistant or an executive can inspect current project
state, roadmap, open decisions, and sprint history without needing access
to the canonical engineering repository. It is **not** a place for direct
development: pull requests opened against this repository will not be
reviewed or merged, and any commit here that didn't come from the
`publish-ai-state` workflow will be overwritten on the next sync.

No production secrets, environment files, or raw customer/lead data are
ever copied here — see the source repository's
`.github/workflows/publish-ai-state.yml` for the allowlist and forbidden-
content validation that enforces this on every sync.

## Contents

- `AGENTS.md` — full engineering ticket registry and operating rules
- `PROJECT_STATE.yaml` — current engineering state snapshot
- `ROADMAP.yaml` — expansion strategy and path to the next milestone
- `OPEN_DECISIONS.yaml` — items awaiting a decision from the project owner
- `CEO_BRIEF.md` — short executive summary
- `SPRINT_HISTORY/` — completed sprint summaries
- `manifest.yaml` — exact source commit and generation metadata for this sync
